planningAudit.notes: Reviewed all19 claim-to-completion intervals against this session command sequence. All were gameplay selection, finite-scope renewal or explicit recovery/decline. No source/report/ledger authoring during the fixed window. Window1 includes one malformed local proposal invocation followed by correct resubmission (no source edits or developer diagnosis); retained as real gameplay-tool overhead. Windows2,4,6 decline after area/no-target guards, followed by owned-state resume outside claims. Progress/status commentary occurred inside some claim-to-completion intervals and remains included as gameplay-service/status overhead, along with reasoning, retrieval, tools and scheduling. Prepared observation waits occurred after claims completed; the watch tool refuses to wait while a claim is open. All19 claims remain included, with no isolated inference claim.

planningLatency.meaning: Current-agent claim-to-completion reasoning/retrieval/tools/scheduling and any intervening progress/status commentary; retained gameplay-service overhead, not isolated model inference

failureCounting.note: Two counter increments have no routine_failed event; do not invent a reason or successful outcome. Stop cancellation/later effects are outside fixed window.

comparison.baselineWholeRunCaveat: Original whole run includes developer/report-support and recovery time; it is less controlled than the transcript-audited gameplay subset.
comparison.higherSkillAndWorkloadCaveat: Same character has higher starting skill levels. Adaptive inventory/target decisions and random resource success differ; this is an observed before/after session, not a randomized isolated controller-speed experiment.

jointAssessment.note: Lower idle alone does not establish success; inspect helper ambiguity, action rate, failures and actual progress. Skill/workload/network differences remain.

operatorNotes: Same account starts at Woodcutting43/Firemaking50; audited baseline started11/1, so this is not a controlled causal benchmark.
Comparable normal-tree woodcutting/Firemaking/inventory workload, with explicitly approved bounded continuation and ordinary recovery.
All runtime and measurement/report tooling prepared and implementation pushed before measurement. No synthetic thinking delays, no second provider.
Preflight details in continuity-preflight.json; existing regressions checked once, new fixture failure corrected with focused reruns.

Early area guards caused two explicit recovery cycles; one no-reachable-target yield caused another. All their paused/idle ticks remain. Work area approvals adapted to observed routes, and observation waits varied20–45seconds to service real refill requests.

Initial proposals used observed coordinate-specific trees; later proposals approved same-name fresh dispatch selection. The automatic resource recipe, safety limits and classifier were never changed during the window.

Existing other cases passed and were not broadly rerun.
One local malformed CLI submission in first planning interval is retained as agent/tool overhead, not silently subtracted.
This is an adaptive online observation, not a controlled causal experiment. Higher starting skills43/50 versus11/1, earlier familiar routes, planner/tool turnaround and servicing cadence differ.

Failure counter29 includes27 recorded routine_failed events and2 additional failed/canceled/invalidated helper attempts without a routine_failed event. Do not force the categories to sum to29 or call all29 durable routine results.
Exact cutoff has217 dispatches,187 verified,29 failed attempts and1 action still in flight. Its later effect/stop cancellation is excluded.

Nineteen claims include16 accepted proposals and3 declines (windows2,4,6) after guarded pauses. No support code, report authorship or ledger upgrades occurred inside claims; no mixed windows are silently removed.
Owner process exited but remained as an unreaped zombie entry; owned game client is absent.
limitations: This cloud agent supplied plans with current tools; no second provider/API key or inaccessible Wartime identity was tested.
A standing tile, helper promise or no-XP tick alone does not establish idle/productivity. Hidden server work remains uncertain.
All-claim and whole-run measurements retain every failure, pause and mixed window; any gameplay-only audit excludes entire mixed windows, without invented developer durations.
Single character and 20-minute window do not prove unlimited autonomy, PvP ability or a causal timing result independent of higher skills/workload.
